properties.name: wow.callers.<service>.commands
properties.description: The commands the service may call, names or patterns; the domain commands alone when empty.

properties.name: wow.callers.<service>.reads
properties.description: The models the service may read on the internal port's read routes, patterns too; every one when empty.

properties.name: wow.peers.<context>.contract
properties.description: Where the peer's contract comes from: `jar`, its api jar, or `manifest`, its Manifest alone.

properties.name: wow.peers.<context>.mode
properties.description: The mode the peer is called in: `service` or `user`, over `wow.peer.mode`.

properties.name: wow.peers.<context>.public-url
properties.description: The base URL of the peer's public routes (user mode).

properties.name: wow.peers.<context>.timeout
properties.description: How long a call to the peer may take, over `wow.peer.timeout`.

properties.name: wow.peers.<context>.url
properties.description: The base URL of the peer's internal port (service mode), never its public port; found when not set.

properties.name: wow.aggregates.[<context>.<aggregate>].clickhouse.history.enabled
properties.description: Whether every commit of the type is kept: `auto`, the Sink's default, keeps it; `true` or `false` decide.

properties.name: wow.aggregates.[<context>.<aggregate>].clickhouse.history.ttl
properties.description: How long the type's history is kept; forever when not set.

properties.name: wow.aggregates.[<context>.<aggregate>].id-generator
properties.description: The id generator that gives the type's new ids, by name.

properties.name: wow.aggregates.[<context>.<aggregate>].log.store
properties.description: The store of `wow.stores` the type's log is on, over `wow.log.store`.

properties.name: wow.aggregates.[<context>.<aggregate>].query.events.store
properties.description: The store of `wow.stores` the type's `events` queries read; its log store when not set.

properties.name: wow.aggregates.[<context>.<aggregate>].query.events.unpinned
properties.description: Whether an `events` query of the type that names no aggregate runs, over its store's.

properties.name: wow.aggregates.[<context>.<aggregate>].query.snapshot.store
properties.description: The store of `wow.stores` the type's `snapshot` queries read, which then keeps a copy of its snapshots; its `snapshot.store` when not set.

properties.name: wow.aggregates.[<context>.<aggregate>].routing
properties.description: How the commands of the type are routed, over `wow.routing` (CommandRouting): `topic` writes them to its context's command topic, accepted once the broker acknowledged them, which needs a topic transport; `partitioned` and `local` are the node's, so they name the routing `wow.routing` gives it.

properties.name: wow.aggregates.[<context>.<aggregate>].snapshot.store
properties.description: The store of `wow.stores` the type's snapshots are kept on, over `wow.snapshot.store`.

properties.name: wow.aggregates.[<context>.<aggregate>].tenant
properties.description: The tenant every aggregate of the type is in, whoever the caller is.

properties.name: wow.stores.<name>.ddl
properties.description: How this store manages the framework's schema, over `wow.ddl`.

properties.name: wow.stores.<name>.query.adaptive.ceiling
properties.description: The most the store's adaptive query bound goes up to, over `wow.query.adaptive.ceiling`.

properties.name: wow.stores.<name>.query.adaptive.floor
properties.description: The least the store's adaptive query bound goes down to, over `wow.query.adaptive.floor`.

properties.name: wow.stores.<name>.query.events.unpinned
properties.description: Whether an `events` query that names no aggregate runs, over `wow.query.events.unpinned`.

properties.name: wow.stores.<name>.query.max-concurrent
properties.description: How many of the store's queries run at once, over `wow.query.max-concurrent`; `0` for no bound.

properties.name: wow.stores.<name>.query.max-queued
properties.description: How many queries beyond the bound wait for a permit, over `wow.query.max-queued`.

properties.name: wow.stores.<name>.query.max-wait
properties.description: How long a query beyond the bound waits for a permit, over `wow.query.max-wait`.

properties.name: wow.stores.<name>.type
properties.description: The store's type: `memory`, `postgres`, `mongo`, `elasticsearch` or a community backend's.

properties.name: wow.stores.<name>.client
properties.description: On elasticsearch: the name of the Rest5Client bean the store opens over; the only one when not set. On mongo: the name of the MongoClient bean the store opens over; the only one when not set.

properties.name: wow.stores.<name>.query-client
properties.description: On elasticsearch: the name of the Rest5Client bean the store's queries use, so they draw on a connection pool of their own instead of the one the snapshot writes use; the store's client when not set.

properties.name: wow.stores.<name>.index-prefix
properties.description: On elasticsearch: a prefix of every index name of the store (<prefix>_wow_snapshot__<context>__<aggregate>), for a cluster several services or environments share; none when not set.

properties.name: wow.stores.<name>.refresh
properties.description: On elasticsearch: when a write becomes visible to searches: none (the default: within the index's refresh interval; a command's snapshot wait never covers this store), wait-for (a snapshot is queryable once its write returns, which only an in-process caller that waits on the store's own snapshot subscription in code can rely on) or immediate (an immediate refresh, for tests).

properties.name: wow.stores.<name>.reindex-requests-per-second
properties.description: On elasticsearch: how many documents a second the store indexes again when its queries map a field an index lacks, so that the documents written before it are found by it too; a search of the field misses them until the rewrite ends. 1000 by default (a million documents in about 17 minutes); -1 for no limit.

properties.name: wow.stores.<name>.database
properties.description: On mongo: the database of the log and the stores on MongoDB: unset, the one spring.mongodb.uri names, else wow.

properties.name: wow.stores.<name>.append-timeout
properties.description: On mongo: how long an append's insert may take: below the default wait timeout, so a command appending during an outage is answered before its wait ends.

properties.name: wow.stores.<name>.sharding
properties.description: On mongo: whether a store on a sharded cluster shards its log, snapshot, timer and reservation collections when it creates them: auto when connected to a mongos with ddl auto, none for a cluster its operators shard.

properties.name: wow.stores.<name>.operation-timeout
properties.description: On mongo: how long each call of a MongoDB store may take besides appends (append-timeout) and the schema's commands (5 minutes): a reply lost on the way fails the call instead of blocking it forever. On postgres: how long each call of a PostgreSQL store may wait for a reply besides the schema's statements (5 minutes) and the queries (their own statement_timeout): a reply lost on the way fails the call, and its connection, instead of blocking it forever.

properties.name: wow.stores.<name>.pool-gauge
properties.description: On mongo: the name of the MongoPoolGauge bean the store's client was built with, when the application has several.

properties.name: wow.stores.<name>.query-read-preference
properties.description: On mongo: the read preference of the snapshot and events queries of a MongoDB store (secondaryPreferred, say), so a free filter scans a secondary rather than the primary the log appends to; the primary when not set. A snapshot read from a secondary may be behind the one a command's wait waited for.

properties.name: wow.stores.<name>.data-source
properties.description: On postgres: the name of the DataSource bean the store opens over; the only one when not set.

properties.name: wow.stores.<name>.query-data-source
properties.description: On postgres: the name of the DataSource bean the store's snapshot and events queries read through, so they do not take the appends' connections; the store's data-source when not set.

properties.name: wow.subscriptions.[<context>.<name>].parked.claim-ttl
properties.description: How long a retry's claim on the entry holds, over `wow.subscription.parked`'s.

properties.name: wow.subscriptions.[<context>.<name>].parked.initial-backoff
properties.description: The wait before the first automatic retry, over `wow.subscription.parked`'s.

properties.name: wow.subscriptions.[<context>.<name>].parked.max-retries
properties.description: How many automatic retries a parked entry of the subscription gets, over `wow.subscription.parked`'s.

properties.name: wow.subscriptions.[<context>.<name>].retry.initial-backoff
properties.description: The wait after the first failure.

properties.name: wow.subscriptions.[<context>.<name>].retry.max-attempts
properties.description: The most attempts of the handler in all, before its aggregate parks.

properties.name: wow.subscriptions.[<context>.<name>].retry.max-backoff
properties.description: The longest wait between two attempts.

properties.name: wow.subscriptions.[<context>.<name>].retry.multiplier
properties.description: How many times longer each wait is than the one before; at least 1.

properties.name: wow.subscriptions.[<context>.<name>].retry.timeout
properties.description: How long one attempt may run before it is cancelled and counts as failed.

properties.name: wow.subscriptions.[<context>.<name>].start
properties.description: Where the subscription starts in a partition it has no checkpoint in: `beginning`, `end` or an instant.

properties.name: wow.schedules.<name>.cron
properties.description: The job's cron, six fields, over its annotation's.

properties.name: wow.schedules.<name>.enabled
properties.description: Whether a SYSTEM or a SHARDED job's instances run; false disables them at startup.

properties.name: wow.schedules.<name>.misfire
properties.description: What a firing missed while no node ran it does, over its annotation's.

properties.name: wow.schedules.<name>.parked.claim-ttl
properties.description: How long a retry's claim on the entry holds, over `wow.subscription.parked`'s.

properties.name: wow.schedules.<name>.parked.initial-backoff
properties.description: The wait before the first automatic retry, over `wow.subscription.parked`'s.

properties.name: wow.schedules.<name>.parked.max-retries
properties.description: How many automatic retries a parked entry of the subscription gets, over `wow.subscription.parked`'s.

properties.name: wow.schedules.<name>.retry.initial-backoff
properties.description: The wait after the first failure.

properties.name: wow.schedules.<name>.retry.max-attempts
properties.description: The most attempts of the handler in all, before its aggregate parks.

properties.name: wow.schedules.<name>.retry.max-backoff
properties.description: The longest wait between two attempts.

properties.name: wow.schedules.<name>.retry.multiplier
properties.description: How many times longer each wait is than the one before; at least 1.

properties.name: wow.schedules.<name>.retry.timeout
properties.description: How long one attempt may run before it is cancelled and counts as failed.

properties.name: wow.schedules.<name>.time-zone
properties.description: The time zone its cron is read in, over its annotation's.

properties.name: wow.http.errors.[<code>].status
properties.description: The HTTP status the code is answered with, 400 to 599: required, an entry without it refuses the start.
